C1781.title: FTC Warns: Unlawful Collection and Use of Consumer Sensitive Data by Connected Vehicles
C1781.summary: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) highlighted that as vehicles become increasingly connected, they can collect vast amounts of sensitive data, including biometrics and driving behavior. Some manufacturers collect and use this data without lawful authorization, underscoring privacy risks from misuse of in-vehicle data interfaces.

references.title: Cars & Consumer Data: On Unlawful Collection & Use
